description: Repeatability: same neutral-driver configuration run twice with identical Philox key/counter must give identical particle states.
fortran_repeatability_note: The Fortran oracle exposes no seed control: random_mod.f90 alloc_random hard-codes iseed1=-7-i and iseed2=-88-i per OpenMP thread, with no COMMAND namelist override. Repeated oracle runs are therefore not a controlled multi-seed experiment; no multi-seed oracle parity is claimed.
